card.name: Modifier word before a set noun
card.fires_on: A modifier or word start that sits just before an expected noun, such as 'answering' before machine, 'IV' before fluids, or 'captive' before supplies. It also fires inside a few split-up words like convalescent or Gopher.

modes.label: Modifier before noun
modes.description: An adjective or abbreviation that begins a fixed two-word phrase, such as answering machine or IV fluids.

modes.description: Partway through a longer or rarer word that is broken into pieces.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on a word that begins a stock phrase, like 'answering' in answering machine or 'IV' in IV fluids.
